content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between the defendant and the applicant the court awarded the applicant personal property and shares in a company while the defendant was awarded a plot of land the court also ordered the applicant to pay the defendant compensation for the higher value of the property received the court declared the dissolution of the marriage and ordered the defendant to repay a debt owed to sl the court considered evidence of psychological and physical violence in the breakdown of the marriage the court also considered the financial situation of both parties in determining the division of property and maintenance payments the court ordered the defendant to pay child maintenance arrears and the costs of the proceedings the court partially upheld the application counterclaim and dismissed certain parts of it both parties were ordered to pay stamp duty and court fees

metadata.cost: - € 880,59 (stamp duty) + € 10,68 (court fees) + € 8 606,98 (professional fees) to be borne by the defendant; € 223,78 (stamp duty) + € 15 789,72 (professional fees) to be borne by the applicant
